component.name: Paperback Reader
component.summary: A tactile, offline-first reading ledger for novels, light novels, and web serials

description.p: Paperback Reader is a tactile, offline-first reading tracker and ledger designed for book lovers, light novel readers, and web serial enthusiasts.

ul.li: Tactile Neo-Brutalist design with paper grain textures
First-class tracking for volume/chapter progress, series, custom multi-membership shelves, and re-reading journeys
Instant offline-first local SQLite caching with background Supabase / REST cloud synchronization
Rich statistics, reading pace estimation, lifetime analytics, and goal progress tracking
Keyboard-first workflow with global shortcuts and quick increment steppers

description.p: Added multi-tag filtering with top 5 frequency collapse, combo search syntax, mobile hardware vibration, and modal button contrast fixes.
Added Lifetime Stats dashboard, expandable genre suggestions, and performance audit optimizations.
